title: Integrity monitoring for alt-PNT: solution-separation FDE, protection levels and a Stanford diagram
summary: A stdlib-only simulated UAV flight with INS, VIO-like velocity, intermittent visual-geolocalization fixes (repetitive-texture outliers, map-misregistration bias, dropouts over water), optional coarse MagNav-like fixes and a GNSS that is jammed and then spoofed. An 8-state EKF with chi-square innovation gating feeds a solution-separation bank that detects, excludes or (with only two sources) alerts and resolves by dead-reckoning consistency, computes horizontal protection levels against an alert limit, and reports MI/HMI, availability, time-to-alert and an ASCII/SVG Stanford diagram. A monitor-off negative control shows the misleading-information events the monitor removes.
verified: ran with python3.14.7 stdlib on 2026-11-06: default run, --magnav, --no-gnss, --al-sweep, 20-seed Monte Carlo for 8 configurations, CSV and SVG writers (SVG rendered with macOS qlmanage and inspected); 15 unit tests pass (python3 -m unittest), and the detection tests were confirmed to fail with detection disabled. Synthetic data only; no real flight log or indexed repo was run.
